drawings.drawing_title: EXPANSION JOINT DETAIL AT THE CONNECTION WITH MIP TUNNEL (RAFT)

classification.notes: This is a detail drawing showing the expansion joint connection between a raft foundation and an adjacent tunnel (M.I.P. tunnel to K.A.A. tunnel), including waterproofing membranes, waterstops, joint filler, stainless steel dowel bars, and raft reinforcement. Since it's N.T.S. (not to scale) with only a few labeled dimensions (500mm joint width, 300mm dowel spacing references, 25mm, 20mm E.J., 50mm screed, 100mm blinding), quantities are limited but some linear/area/volume takeoffs per unit length of joint are derivable.

drawings.drawing_title: EXPANSION JOINT DETAIL AT THE CONNECTION WITH MIP TUNNEL (EXTERNAL WALL)

classification.notes: Detail section showing expansion joint connection between two tunnel structures (K.A.A.R. tunnel side and M.I.P. tunnel side external wall), including reinforcement callouts, waterstops, dowel bars, and joint accessories. Not to scale detail with dimensions for wall thickness, dowel bar spacing/length, and joint widths.

drawings.drawing_title: EXPANSION JOINT DETAIL AT THE CONNECTION WITH MIP TUNNEL (TOP SLAB)

classification.notes: Detail drawing showing expansion joint connection between M.I.P. tunnel and K.A.A.R. tunnel at top slab, including waterproofing, waterstops, dowel bars, and reinforcement. Not to scale, includes keyplan and general notes.

drawings.drawing_title: EXPANSION JOINT DETAIL AT THE CONNECTION WITH EXISTING BASEMENT OF MASJID EL NABAWI (TOP SLAB)

classification.notes: This is a structural detail drawing showing the expansion joint connection between a tunnel structure and an existing basement slab (Masjid El Nabawi).
